faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Students pay no subscription and no platform service fee in V1 — only the lesson or package price shown.
faq.a2: Students pay in-platform at checkout. Apoindar takes a marketplace commission (12% Free, 7% Premium) and the rest is settled to the teacher. Payout scheduling is finalised with the payment provider.
faq.q3: What's the difference between Free and Premium?
faq.a3: Free: 12% commission, 1 active listing, 3 active students, basic calendar. Premium (299₺/mo or 2 990₺/yr): 7% commission, unlimited listings and students, recurring lessons, advanced calendar and CRM, Growth Dashboard. 14-day free trial, no card.
faq.q4: What happens if I cancel Premium?
faq.a4: You stay on Premium until the paid period ends, then move to Free. Nothing is deleted — extra listings become inactive and extra students stay saved but read-only for Premium tools.
faq.a5: Yes. Bookings follow the teacher's cancellation policy; refunds are processed through Apoindar and reflected in both the student's and teacher's records.
faq.a6: A dedicated iOS and Android app is planned (React Native + Expo) using the same backend. The web app is fully responsive today.

trust.title: Trust & Safety
trust.intro: Apoindar is built so that booking and paying on-platform is genuinely better than doing it over chat.
trust.p1b: Every paid lesson has a confirmation and a receipt you can refer back to.
trust.p2b: Clear policies and a real refund process handled by Apoindar.
trust.p3b: Teacher profiles are reviewed before they appear in search.
trust.p4b: Server-side authorization on every action; private student data is never exposed to other providers.
trust.p5b: Report a teacher, booking or listing and our team reviews it.
trust.legalNote: Formal Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are published before public launch.
